faq_heading: New construction in Fraser, Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in Fraser, Vancouver sold for?
faq.a: 53 houses sold in Fraser, Vancouver at a median of $1,980,000, with the middle half between $1,675,000 and $2,625,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Fraser, Vancouver?
faq.a: In Fraser, Vancouver, condos were quickest at 10 days at a median, and duplexes slowest at 21 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Fraser, Vancouver are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Fraser, Vancouver, duplexes had the newest median build year, 2026.

items.t: 53 houses sold in Fraser, Vancouver at a median of $1,980,000 (middle half $1,675,000 to $2,625,000). A typical house in Fraser, Vancouver spent 16 days on the market and closed at 97.3% of the asking price.
In Fraser, Vancouver, condos sold at a median of $647,000 across 36 sales, and the middle half closed between $499,000 and $765,125. The median condo sat 10 days and sold for 97.9% of list.
Fraser, Vancouver: 37 duplexes sold at a median of $1,685,000, with the middle half between $1,460,000 and $1,910,000. The median duplex took 21 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Fraser compares with the rest of Vancouver East

items.t: Houses in Fraser have the highest median of the 15 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,980,000, ahead of Fraserview VE at $1,925,000; the lowest is Collingwood at $1,510,000.

Condos in Fraser have the 7th highest median of 13 Vancouver East sub-areas, $647,000. Collingwood is lowest at $520,000 and Main highest at $898,950. Renfrew VE ($638,000) sits just below and Grandview-Woodland ($664,900) sits just above.

Of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas with 5 or more duplex sales, Fraser ranks third highest at $1,685,000; the range is $1,112,500 (Strathcona) to $1,919,000 (Main). Grandview-Woodland ($1,585,000) sits just below and Mount Pleasant VE ($1,735,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Fraser, Vancouver (median 2026) and houses the oldest (median 1950), a gap of 76 years.
